China blocks SoftBank’s ABB Robotics acquisition as talks continue

ABB confirmed a Chinese prohibition to The Robot Report; the companies continue discussions and have not announced a global cancellation.

The Robot Report ↗5 November 2026English editorial summary
StoryImages 1Videos 1

A new approval obstacle

ABB confirmed to The Robot Report that China’s foreign-investment security-review office prohibited SoftBank’s acquisition of ABB Robotics in China. The previously agreed $5.375 billion transaction therefore faces a significant approval obstacle.

China’s role in the business

The report says Shanghai produces about 90% of ABB robots serving Chinese customers. Concerns about robot data being used for overseas AI training were reported by the Financial Times; that reported rationale should be distinguished from ABB’s confirmation of the prohibition itself.

Discussions continue

ABB and SoftBank say they remain in close dialogue and are working constructively. This is not an announcement that the entire global deal has been cancelled. Customers should follow further transaction updates; the report does not announce a halt to existing robot deliveries or service.
